the Premier League: Manchester United and Liverpool play in the Premier League, the top football league in England.
曼聯和利物浦都在英格蘭超級聯賽踢球，那是英格蘭最高級別的足球聯賽。
a premier hotel: For their wedding, they booked a premier hotel with five stars, a rooftop pool, and the best service in town.
他們為婚禮訂了一間頂級飯店，有五星評等、頂樓泳池，還有城裡最好的服務。
the premier: The premier, who leads the provincial government, announced a new plan to build more public housing.
領導省政府的總理宣布了一項興建更多社會住宅的新計畫。
a premier event: Wimbledon is a premier event in the tennis world, and every top player dreams of winning it.
溫布頓是網球界的首要盛事，每位頂尖選手都夢想贏得冠軍。
a presidential election: Taiwan holds a presidential election every four years, when citizens vote to choose the country's leader.
台灣每四年舉行一次總統選舉，屆時公民投票選出國家領導人。
the presidential palace: Tourists lined up outside the presidential palace, hoping to see where the country's president works.
遊客在總統府外排隊，希望看看國家總統工作的地方。
presidential candidates: The three presidential candidates debated on TV last night about how they would improve the economy.
三位總統候選人昨晚在電視上辯論他們將如何改善經濟。
the previous day: I was very tired in class because I had stayed up late studying for the test the previous day.
我上課時非常累，因為前一天我為了準備考試熬夜到很晚。
previous experience: I had no previous experience in cooking before I started working at the restaurant last summer.
去年夏天開始在餐廳工作之前，我沒有任何先前的烹飪經驗。
a previous engagement: I'm sorry I can't come to your party on Friday because I have a previous engagement that evening.
很抱歉我星期五不能參加你的派對，因為那天晚上我已有約會。
on previous occasions: On previous occasions he arrived late, so this time his boss warned him to be on time.
他以前幾次都遲到，所以這次老闆警告他要準時。
a previous conviction: The judge gave the thief a longer sentence because he had a previous conviction for stealing cars.
法官判那名小偷較重的刑期，因為他有偷車的前科。
prime minister: Japan's prime minister, the head of the government, met reporters after the meeting with other world leaders.
日本首相，也就是政府首長，在與其他世界領袖會面後接受記者採訪。
in the prime of life: My father was in the prime of life at forty, strong enough to run marathons and full of energy at work.
我父親四十歲時正值人生的黃金時期，強壯到能跑馬拉松，工作也精力充沛。
a prime example: The Great Wall is a prime example of how ancient people built huge structures without modern machines.
長城是古人在沒有現代機械下建造巨大建築的典型例子。
prime time: The most popular shows are broadcast during prime time, when most families watch TV after dinner.
最受歡迎的節目都在黃金時段播出，那時大多數家庭在晚餐後看電視。
prime numbers: Prime numbers such as 2, 3, 5, and 7 can only be divided by one and themselves.
像2、3、5和7這樣的質數只能被1和它們自己整除。
the prime suspect: The police named the victim's business partner as the prime suspect because his fingerprints were on the knife.
警方把被害人的生意夥伴列為頭號嫌犯，因為刀上有他的指紋。
of prime importance: For airline pilots, passenger safety is of prime importance; it always comes first, before speed or comfort.
對航空機師來說，乘客安全至關重要；它永遠排在第一，優先於速度或舒適。
prime real estate: Land near the new MRT station has become prime real estate, and prices there have doubled in five years.
新捷運站附近的土地已成為精華地段房產，那裡的價格五年內翻了一倍。
primitive societies: In primitive societies, people hunted animals and gathered plants because they did not know how to farm.
在原始社會中，人們因為不懂得耕作而打獵和採集植物。
primitive conditions: After the earthquake, survivors lived in primitive conditions without electricity, running water, or proper toilets.
地震過後，倖存者生活在簡陋的生活條件下，沒有電、自來水或像樣的廁所。
primitive instincts: When we sense danger, our primitive instincts take over and tell us to fight or run away.
當我們察覺危險時，原始本能就會接管，叫我們反擊或逃跑。
primitive technology: With only primitive technology like stone tools, early humans still managed to build shelters and make fire.
早期人類只有石器這類原始的技術，卻仍設法搭建住所並生火。
prior to the meeting: Please read the report prior to the meeting so that we can spend our time discussing it instead.
請在會議之前先讀完報告，這樣我們就能把時間花在討論上。
prior knowledge: No prior knowledge of computers is needed for this beginner course; we will start from the very basics.
這門入門課程不需要任何電腦的先備知識；我們會從最基礎的開始。
without prior notice: The store closed without prior notice, so customers who came the next morning were surprised to find it empty.
那家店未經事先通知就關門了，所以隔天早上來的顧客驚訝地發現店裡空無一物。
a prior commitment: I'd love to join you for dinner, but I have a prior commitment that night with my grandparents.
我很想和你們一起吃晚餐，但那天晚上我已經和祖父母有約了。
have prior claim to: As the oldest child, she believed she should have prior claim to the bigger bedroom when the family moved.
身為長女，她認為搬家時她應該對那間較大的臥室有優先權。
prior experience: Applicants with prior experience in customer service will be given priority for the summer job.
有客服相關先前經驗的應徵者，將優先錄取這份暑期工作。
